$comment: SHARED PRICING CONTRACT — single source of truth for web/landing and web/server. termio uses a one-time LIFETIME license (NO subscription): pay once, own it forever including all future updates, with a 30-day money-back guarantee and a 7-day no-account free trial. Personal licenses come in two tiers by device count: Solo (1 Mac) and Pro (up to 3 Macs). A volume Team option exists for 5+ seats. Do not change this shape without updating BOTH consumers (web/landing/src/data/pricing.ts and web/server/src/pricing.ts).
